features.name: Carnage and Doomsday Spins

review:
Apocalypse Super xNudge is a 6x4 doomsday slot where xNudge Wilds on reels 2 to 5 drop to the bottom of their reel, adding +1 to their multiplier for every step. The Super xNudge Wild only lands on reels 3 and 4, and it activates only when both land on the same row.

Three scatters start Carnage Spins and four start Doomsday Spins, both centred on stacking wild multipliers. A paid feature spin ensures a pair of Super xNudge Wilds in the same row. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, and it tops out at 20,000x.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
